name: HSV Hold
description: Removes the color from every pixel except those close to a hue/saturation/value, which keep their color.

params.name: hue
params.description: Key hue in degrees; a negative value ignores the hue

params.name: sat
params.description: Key saturation; a negative value ignores the saturation

params.name: val
params.description: Key value (brightness); a negative value ignores the value

params.name: similarity
params.description: Distance from the key that keeps its color

params.name: blend
params.description: Width of the soft edge above the similarity; 0 = hard cut
